name: Per-call policy resolution
sourceDerivedExpectations: Approved explicit mode outranks session projection; session override outranks configured default.
Session header cwd is the workspace root; sessionId follows that session, agentless call omits it.
Agentless/configured root fallback must be absolute; reject relative execution-world root rather than resolving it silently.
knownBadAndLimits: Two sessions with different cwd/mode cannot share resolved policy.
Do not infer runner selection from policy service config or replace session cwd with process cwd.

name: Session log mode and invariant
sourceDerivedExpectations: setSandboxMode appends one sandbox/mode event; state changes through the projection fold, initially null.
Replay last mode separately per session; source=delegation is event data and not an approval token.
Invariant validates loaded snapshots and newly dispatched sandbox/mode values; unrelated events ignored.
Register companion under package ownership; retain native registration disposer.
knownBadAndLimits: No out-of-band mode store or automatic wider grant from an event.
Standalone setSandboxMode has no internal approval check in inspected code; caller authorization was not inspected and needs explicit T3 qualification.

name: Request-time policy/environment context
sourceDerivedExpectations: No agent session produces empty context.
Danger-full-access renders policy and does not ask describe for environment.
Undefined provider description makes no environment assertion/event.
Same session object and identical JSON(mode,environment) appends once; changed data appends again.
Retain declared unknown temp/identity facts, partial/unavailable and per-call/per-session/host distinctions without inventing mounted tools.
knownBadAndLimits: Repeated identical request must not append duplicate environment event.
Narrative facts are not native isolation proof; session writer durability is unqualified here.

name: Exact argv wrapping and configuration
sourceDerivedExpectations: Configured runner and nonempty single-line failure signatures must be paired; probe timeout must be finite positive, including refusal of zero.
confine checks already-aborted signal before resolving policy/grants.
Wrap exact argv after native separator; preserve Unicode and shell-sensitive arguments as argv elements.
Configured runner skips built-in selection/probes and reports full as operator assertion; unknown temp/identity metadata retained.
No usable platform runner raises structured SANDBOX_UNAVAILABLE and does not return unconfined argv.
knownBadAndLimits: Do not join argv into a shell command or append user arguments before the separator.
Metadata full from configured runner does not prove real containment or justify calling a real command.

name: Selection caching and honest environment facts
sourceDerivedExpectations: Linux native chain prefers bwrap then Landlock; Darwin/Windows have a single candidate and do not probe for arbitration.
No candidate is unavailable; multiple candidates probe in order and retain full/partial result; cached verdict reused.
Windows ACL reports partial; Landlock report may be partial; never upgrade from version or name alone.
bwrap workspace-write temp is per-call except root / or /tmp; landlock/seatbelt use host temp/identity.
Windows workspace-write with sessionId reports per-session temp, without session per-call; read-only uses host temp, identity restricted-token.
knownBadAndLimits: Scripted selection checks are future source conformance only, not native platform qualification.
A declared full/partial or sole unprobed candidate still needs real denied-effect proof for required isolation.

name: Canonical roots and runner profile dialects
sourceDerivedExpectations: canonicalPath uses native component resolution; on failure returns original spelling, not invented fallback root.
writableRoots returns canonical deduplicated workspace,/tmp,platform tmpdir only for workspace-write; other modes return empty list.
bwrap workspace-write uses private tmpfs and workspace bind; read-only has no workspace write bind.
Landlock grants /dev/null and workspace-write grants /tmp/workspace via launcher helper; exact external launcher ABI remains unqualified.
Seatbelt embeds escaped canonical roots in deny-file-write profile; quotes/backslashes cannot break SBPL string.
knownBadAndLimits: Do not infer network/process confinement from file-policy argv or profile text.
Profile text/argv equivalence is separate from real filesystem denial, symlink races and native backend grants.

name: Runner diagnostics and spawn attribution
sourceDerivedExpectations: classifyRunnerFailure requires nonzero non-null exit, allowed-code match when declared, fatal nonblank substring on a remaining line after case-insensitive exact informational-line exclusion.
Preserve original matched stderr line in detail; informational exclusion is exact full-line, not substring/trim.
matchesSignature also requires nonzero non-null exit but DOES NOT filter empty signatures: empty signature matches a nonzero exit even with empty stderr; do not conflate it with classifier filtering.
isRunnerSpawnFailure requires usable cwd plus ENOENT/EACCES and exact runner path/syscall conditions; missing runner or unusable cwd is not runner evidence.
Windows failure rule is exit127-gated; Landlock uses its imported launcher failure tuple with an exact informational partial-enforcement line; per-backend signatures stay separate.
knownBadAndLimits: A user command can print a matching diagnostic; helper classification is dialect inference, not independent proof no command ran.
No union of backend denial dialects or exit code alone as universal failure proof.
Do not silently sanitize the public matchesSignature helper to equal classifyRunnerFailure.

name: Windows session/workspace temp lifecycle
sourceDerivedExpectations: Session+workspace pair reuses private random temp capability during provider lifetime, workspace grant remains per workspace.
Different sessions/workspaces get separate temp identity; agentless invocation delegates per-call temp ownership to runner.
Partial materialization cleans up acquired grant/temp and preserves cleanup failures.
Provider dispose attempts all grants/temp removals and reports failures; standing workspace ACE intentionally remains while SID allocations are freed.
Crash residue is not automatically adopted by a fresh provider; fresh random path/SID prevents identity reuse.
knownBadAndLimits: These are inspected provider/source obligations only; Win32 FFI/ACL token/ABI/native process effects among pending427 requirements remain unqualified.
Do not run Windows/ACL mutation or subprocesses during this documentary phase.
